title: Malmgren tracked by Majestic guardians

tellings.quote: They not only CIA but you know all the majestic all these guardians they also themselves to protect the world.

plain: Harold Malmgren, a former presidential advisor, says he was watched not only by the CIA but also by what he calls "the majestic, all these guardians". Majestic is a name used in UFO circles for a supposed secret group in charge of the subject. In his telling, these guardians see their job as protecting the world.
